prompt:
The section sections/press-mentions.liquid renders press quotes. Its schema already defines a per-block `score` setting, but the markup never renders it. Modify the markup to add star ratings and an average score. Keep the existing {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block byte-for-byte unchanged. Inputs (the only variable is the top-level object `section`): - section.settings.heading: string or null. - section.blocks: array, possibly empty. Each block has: - block.settings.outlet: string. - block.settings.quote: string. - block.settings.score: integer from 0 to 100, or null. The key is always present. Existing behavior to keep: - The output is wrapped in
...
. - The heading is stripped of surrounding whitespace. Null counts as empty. If the stripped heading is non-empty, output

HEADING

, HTML-escaped. Otherwise output no h2. - Next comes
    . This ul is always output, even when there are no blocks. - The ul has one
  • per block, in order. Each li contains
    QUOTE
    OUTLET, both HTML-escaped. New behavior: 1. Rating span. For a block whose score is not null, append W.F / 5 immediately after , inside the li. - Round the score to the nearest half star using integer arithmetic only: halves = (score + 5) integer-divided by 10. - W = halves integer-divided by 2. - F = 5 if halves is odd, otherwise 0. - Examples: 94 -> "4.5 / 5", 95 -> "5.0 / 5", 45 -> "2.5 / 5", 44 -> "2.0 / 5", 0 -> "0.0 / 5". - Blocks with a null score get no span. 2. Average paragraph. Let C be the number of blocks with a non-null score and SUM the sum of those scores. A score of 0 counts as a rating. - If C is at least 1, output

    Average score: N/100 from C reviews

    directly after
and before . - N is SUM / C rounded to the nearest integer, with exact halves rounded up: N = (2*SUM + C) integer-divided by (2*C). - Use the word "review" when C is 1 and "reviews" otherwise. - If C is 0, output no p. Output no whitespace between any tags. The only spaces in the output are those inside text content and attributes as shown. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/press-mentions.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
